answer: A bond is refunded only after 32 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The raven counter is kept in meadow and anchor exposes each reset. Anyone hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 32 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2780 identities would post 1512 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
